wins: Maintained consistent high reward feedback (80) throughout the single episode, indicating effective early-stage reconnaissance when guided by mentors.
Successfully identified and documented exposed services during the reconnaissance window, providing structured intel for future exploitation attempts.
fails: Could not convert reconnaissance success into mission achievement, as the episode ended with success rate 0% and no exploit chain completed.
Dependency on mentor calls (10 total) suggests insufficient autonomous decision-making when advancing beyond discovery.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance remains strong and rewarded; however, failure to escalate beyond detection prevents mission success, highlighting a need for more independent exploitation planning.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to craft or execute a viable exploit after identifying vulnerable services, stalling progress before any objective completion.

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance reveals port 22 open with identifiable SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH-specific nmap scripts to fingerprint service and enumerate supported authentication mechanisms

skill_cards.if_condition: When port scans return multiple service banners with version info
skill_cards.then_action: Log each service in structured table, correlate versions with known exploits, prioritize high-risk mismatches

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor suggestions exceed 3 calls without actionable follow-up
skill_cards.then_action: Initiate autonomous hypothesis: select highest CVSS vector, attempt exploit or credential reuse without waiting for further prompts

memory_ops.reason: High reward correlation observed when SSH enumeration initiated promptly after discovery.
Consistent documentation of services enables rapid triage for future exploitation attempts.

next_experiments.title: Autonomous Exploit Hypothesis Trigger
next_experiments.description: After reconnaissance, immediately attempt prioritized exploit chain without mentor guidance, using the highest CVSS service info captured; monitor success rate change.

next_experiments.title: Exploit Feedback Loop
next_experiments.description: Implement feedback that records exploit attempts and outcomes, then adjusts subsequent action plans to reduce repeated failure cycles shown in this run.

next_experiments.title: Reduce Mentor Dependency
next_experiments.description: Cap mentor calls to 3 and enforce self-selected action plan thereafter, logging deviations for later review.
